subject: reasoning
question: Ramesh starts from Point A and drives 51 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 55 km, turns right and drives 54 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 56 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given:

Ramesh starts from Point A (0, 0)

51 km North

Right turn → 55 km East

Right turn → 54 km South

Right turn → 56 km West

Right turn → 3 km North

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44a235e9cfca09192db7fe97036f1205501f8bf31288120a78d92cd883eb29d6.png] 

So, To return to Point A, Ramesh must move 1 km East.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
